_description: Creation-fee derivation matrix (docs/spec.md 'Creation Fee'): fee = max(floor, P × bps(distance) ÷ 10,000) with bps linear from 1,000 at zero distance to 500 at 432,000 blocks (flat beyond), truncating integer division, floor = 60,000 uveil (600,000 gas at the 0.1 uveil/gas consensus floor). The chain (x/secrets/types.CreationFee) and every client cost estimator assert this matrix in CI so the fee cannot drift between implementations. pool_uveil is the FEE BASE — the value the curve is applied to. Since the guardian cost-recovery change (July 2026) that base is the pool's TIME component (rate x distance x max_shares x bump), not the whole pool: the curve prices a selection draw and is never charged on the gas reimbursements the creator also funds. The arithmetic these vectors pin is unchanged, so they remain valid verbatim; the field keeps its name because this corpus is append-only; distance_blocks the secret's distance; fee_uveil the exact expected fee; regime whether the floor or the percentage curve priced it. Append-only, like every corpus in this directory: new vectors may be added, existing vectors are never edited or removed.
